title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions — Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
**Clause C1 — Who cancels.** Only the subscriber can cancel a Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product.

**Clause C2 — Full refund.** A subscription cancelled within the subscription's full-refund window, counted in calendar days after purchase, with no benefit use is refunded in full.

**Clause C3 — Otherwise.** Otherwise an up-front price is refunded for unused full months only when the subscription refunds unused full months of an up-front term cancelled after the window, and a monthly subscription stops at the end of the paid month.

**Clause C4 — Early termination fee.** A monthly-billed subscription cancelled before the subscription's commitment number of installments are paid carries the subscription's early termination fee, charged as its own charge.

**Clause C5 — One refund per charge.** Each charge can be refunded at most once. Whether a charge has already been refunded is read from the subscription's records before any refund is recorded: a refund already recorded against that same charge means the charge has been refunded.

**Clause C6 — Miles.** A miles price is refunded as miles to the Summit membership.

**Clause C7 — Transfer.** Subscriptions are never transferred to another person when the subscription is not transferable.

## C2 and C3 as a table

Clause C3 applies whenever C2 does not ("otherwise"), so the two conditions of C2 give four combinations:

| Cancelled within the full-refund window after purchase | Any benefit use recorded | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Refunded in full (C2) |
| Yes | Yes | C3 |
| No | No | C3 |
| No | Yes | C3 |

Under C3 the result depends on how the term is paid:

| How the term is paid | Subscription refunds unused full months after the window | Result under C3 |
|---|---|---|
| Up front | Yes | Up-front price refunded for unused full months |
| Up front | No | No refund of the up-front price for unused months |
| Monthly | Not applicable | Subscription stops at the end of the paid month |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Commitment boundary.** With a hypothetical commitment of 12 installments, a monthly-billed subscription cancelled after 11 installments are paid carries the early termination fee as a separate charge; one cancelled after 12 installments are paid does not.
- **Second refund of one charge.** A term price that already has a refund recorded against it is not refunded again, whatever the reason given for the second request.
- **Window.** With a hypothetical full-refund window of 14 calendar days, a subscription cancelled 5 days after purchase with no benefit use is refunded in full; one cancelled 5 days after purchase after a covered bag was used, or one cancelled 40 days after purchase, falls under C3.
- **Request by another person.** A request to cancel made by someone other than the subscriber does not cancel the subscription under C1.
